afterFileEdit.command: command -v shp >/dev/null 2>&1 && shp hook post-edit --agent cursor || true

afterShellExecution.command: command -v shp >/dev/null 2>&1 && shp hook post-shell --agent cursor || true

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: if command -v shp >/dev/null 2>&1; then shp hook working --agent cursor; else echo '{"continue":true}'; fi

preToolUse.command: if command -v shp >/dev/null 2>&1; then shp hook pre-edit --agent cursor; else echo '{"permission":"allow"}'; fi

sessionStart.command: command -v shp >/dev/null 2>&1 && shp hook session-start --agent cursor || true

stop.command: command -v shp >/dev/null 2>&1 && shp hook stop --agent cursor || true
